description.value: Japan Sushi is a sushi-focused Japanese restaurant in Langley offering online ordering and takeout service. Located in the city center, it's accessible to touring cyclists seeking convenient, casual Japanese cuisine options. The restaurant specializes in sushi and provides quick service for travelers.
